steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You... dare to disobey me?
Ted shoots her in the calf. The girl staggers a few steps and keeps herself from falling by leaning on the spikes. She keeps her head down and says nothing.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: A piece of trash, did you act without even thinking? If you rebel again, I'm gonna shoot you.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Come here! Do what you are supposed to do!
This time, she doesn't follow the orders and slowly looks up at Anne, speaking for the first time.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: You said you would save me... Head nurse... Now, I want to hear the truth...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Can... I still be saved?

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: If there is hope, even if I have to betray you and side with that man... I will do so to live on... they are still... waiting for me...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: But if there isn't, I...
Her voice grows weaker. Debris keeps falling from her body, and the cracks on her body begin to widen.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Tell me the truth... please...
Anne chokes up. The young girl's pleading question has rendered her speechless. You can already tell the answer from her reaction.
The girl is beyond hope. Anne can't bring herself to say it, and you decide to—

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You can. With Anne and Iron here... They can definitely save you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You need to hold on. Stop going down the wrong track. Stop being used by that man.
She ignores your answer and continues to stare at Anne, waiting for her answer.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: I don't want well-meaning lies! I don't need it... Please tell me the truth.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Stop playing tricks! Your life is mine, dead or alive. You must obey my orders! Kill them!
Ted fires again, but the bullets are bounced off with the black windblade. She is stronger, but the backlash on her is also evidently worse.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: No. Stop using power. You are...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: ...Then tell me, Anne... Can I still be saved?

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: This kid is no exception... A person who has lost their hope simply can't endure torture like this, yet she perseveres until now.
She needs hope, but where is hope? Is there really a way to save her?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Once a person is infested by Mania, the mutation will only ever worsen and eventually turn them into Corruptors. But you are an exception.
Smash—! The crystals shatter. You reach out and crush the hard contaminated spike in your hand, which is glowing with crimson beams.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Come, Sinner. Accept my shackles. I'll suppress your Mania.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, don't.
You know how dangerous this is, but at this point, your determination drives your action. You turn your gaze at the collapsing young girl.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: ...What do you want to do?

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Save me? You can't even protect yourself without Sinners.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Hah, you're lying... The shackles are to control Sinners...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: You are just like him... You covet our power and force us to fight, and are willing to use any means.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I need help from you guys, but I've never needed slaves.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I am the one who binds you. I won't make you do evil again or let you become a monster.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: ...You can't guarantee that... Even you can't take it. You're lying!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Anne hasn't given up. Iron is still here, and so am I. You are not alone in this. As long as someone is reaching for hope, then you have hope too.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Come, Sinner. You are no one's slave, nor are you a prisoner of Mania.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You still have somewhere you want to go back to, right?
She looks at you like she's struggling, but her hard shell has begun to disintegrate. Her stiff mask slowly cracks and reveals a vulnerable look.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: ...Is it not too late? Can... I still turn back now...?
You lift your hand being burnt by the shackles and reach out to her. The red beams illuminate the darkness, giving her soulless eyes the first light.
Her fractured body seems to suddenly regain strength. The dark smoke is cleared away. She approaches you, almost trotting and holding out her hand—
Is she... Smiling?
That smile is soon swallowed up in the raging contamination. Ted pushes the button and rips the light in the young girl's eyes apart.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: No—!!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You are mine! Dead or alive!! You won't escape!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's too late. Even if he doesn't do anything, your Mania is already beyond cure. Everyone in SALVA knows it, including you. It's time to accept the reality.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Chief, no! You can't tell!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content:
How much you have given up and how much evil you have done for that false hope?
Don't you want to be human? Then turn back.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: ...Is that so...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Even if I go back now... I'll only give them trouble, right?
Bang, bang—

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: What are you waiting for? Kill them! I am the one who has kept you alive! Your life is mine! If you disobey me, you'll... Aaahhhh!
A black windblade strikes Ted and knocks his gun away, then it turns into a black sludge pinning him against the wall.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Ah... Ah... H-how dare you...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I placed a safety trigger! If you hurt me, that capsule will...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: The capsule will then be activated and turn me into a monster... I know. I know everything, but none of it matters now...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Since the day you bought me, you've hated me, chained me, locked me in a cage, and beat me. Every one of your men could abuse me how they wanted.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: You tortured me by any means possible and didn't even allow me to speak.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: I know, Ted, that it's because you're <color=#fb9259>terrified</color> of me.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Sinners have ruined your ambition. You hate us and are scared of us, yet you're jealous and covet our power. That's why you humiliate me, control me, and make me your slave.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: What a joke. You... are so weak.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Shut up! Don't look at me like that! Don't look down on me! You are nothing but a dog! A monster! I am the master! I'll kill you right now! I'll kill you!

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: I have no master.
The black sludge tightens and spreads down from the neck along the skin. The man struggles as he wails in horror.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...She's so strong. So this is how strong her power is?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But this will only give her a worse backlash of Mania.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: No! Stop!! Stay away from me!!
Crash—
There is the crumbling sound of the mechanical parts on Ted's body, then sludge dissolves. He collapses to the ground, groping his body in panic.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...The transmitter ...broke?

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: I'm not interested... in you.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: ...I'm free...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content:
...What ...should I do next...
How much... time do I have left...
As if something that has been supporting her suddenly left, the girl's skin begins to crack and turns into a dark crimson residue.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: This kid is no exception... A person who has lost their hope simply can't endure torture like this, yet she perseveres until now.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: No... I'll save you, and so will Iron. There's still hope. You can come back. Don't give up...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: ...Just tell me the truth ...It's okay ... There's no going back anyway...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: At least I'm able to reclaim some ...something that belongs to me...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Thank you, Anne... You are the only person... who ever gave me hope...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Sorry...
The dark smoke rages as it emits from her body and corrodes her. She can no longer lift up her eyes, but she remains facing you, trying to hold on.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: This body is about to be seized... Before that, the Chief of Minos...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: I want... you to end my life...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content:
Not as a slave to anyone, nor a crazy monster... But as a Sinner... I'll pay for my sins...
I... accept your judgment...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Tell me your name, Sinner. I will judge your sin, and I won't forget you.
She smiles.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: I... forgot...
The contamination rages on like a hurricane. Her words shatter along with her body, and you fail to catch her last words.
